description: Get recent seismic events in and around Switzerland from the Swiss Seismological Service (SED) at ETH Zürich. Returns earthquakes and optionally quarry blasts, sorted by most recent first.

days.description: Number of past days to search (default: 30, max: 365)

include_blasts.description: Include quarry blasts in results (default: false — earthquakes only)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20)

name: get_recent_earthquakes
